title: Repository reference records
description: Product-neutral shape for resolving an adapter display alias to a canonical repository id. Canonical identity is repositories[].id in the repository inventory; this registry references those ids and never redefines their shape.

references.description: May be empty: the bootstrap template ships no references, and an Instance adds one entry per verified adapter alias.

kind.description: Closed for the MVP: the only reference kind is a folder display name inside a Cursor workspace file.

alias.description: The human-readable display label exactly as the adapter writes it. A label, not an identity.

repository_id.description: The canonical id this alias resolves to. Lowercase kebab-case, and it must exist as repositories[].id in the repository inventory.

sources.description: Every place the display alias is actually written. Provenance only: the adapter text itself is not copied here.

artifact.description: Instance-relative path to the adapter file that carries the alias. A leading slash, a drive-letter prefix, any backslash, and any `..` path segment (in any position) are rejected as far as one pattern can express it.

pointer.description: Exact location of the alias inside the artifact, e.g. folders[name=<alias>].name.
